## R Markdown

```{r}
#ignore the Rproj - do not commit it 
#gitignore is basically saying anything start starts as .() is ignored and anything that ends with *.() means wont be tracked as well 
## .() for start *.() for end, ex. *.Rproj 
#commit the changes done to gitignore 

#SHA tells us the version - the code here is the value used to go back to that specific commit version 

#connecting to github 
library(usethis)
usethis::use_github()

#../ (sends it back a file - ex if in code folder, it will come out of it and then be in the main folder) (../data = get out of current folder and then go into data folder) - ex. "../data/penguins.csv"
#can also do here::here() to move to main folder from the start - ex. read_csv(here::here("data/penguins.csv))
```
